catalogueScope.scope: Reviewed exact catalogue bytes and version-specific integration; rc.3 accepted on macOS locally and Linux at the recorded commit. Not general business-health certification.

limitations: Optional health executor is not an OS sandbox and imported results are historical.
Crashed state writers require explicit token-bound recovery of proven orphan locks; unsafe or legacy locks fail closed.
Release evidence applies only to its exact archive, commit and checked DSH versions; a minimum host declaration does not certify future hosts.

history.scope: Detailed past test, release, upstream and live-acceptance records are retained in Git history; historical evidence is not current certification.

release016.scope: Published 0.1.6 metadata patch retaining 0.1.5 behavior; archive/public verification details in archivedVerification, not the unpublished development build.

archivedVerification.scope: Full dated records retrievable with git show <commit>:<path>; sha256 covers the original file bytes. Historical results apply only to recorded inputs, archives and commits, not current source.

upstreamStatus20261024.scope: GitHub issue/PR states refreshed only; maintainer notes remain historical. No source-handler, npm-method or real-install acceptance.

market932.remaining: Maintainer confirmed 1.66.43 adds full-packument fallback; warning or safe failure when both lookups fail remains a separate change.

store22.remaining: Await a usable npm installation method, then verify a fresh install.

rc3Adaptation20261024.scope: Historical rc.3 acceptance for the exact unpublished source archive and recorded CI commit; no Windows/model/account or general business certification. Full detail in archivedVerification.
rc3Adaptation20261024.macOS: Same-tgz host/tool/skill, browser/navigation/drafts, model-listing fixtures; production requests 0, owned resources removed.

fixedCohort.status: passed and replayed; honest FP/FN retained, not ecosystem accuracy

remote.scope: Historical exact-commit checks; not current branch CI.

sourceContext.scope: toolVersion is the checker metadata version; certifiedExactVersions are DSH hosts. Development changes are not npm 0.1.6 delivery.

latestLocalAcceptance.scope: Unpublished 0.1.7-dev source, checker metadata 0.1.6; current real-host acceptance on macOS arm64/DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 only. No push, merge, release, account/model, Windows or general business certification.
latestLocalAcceptance.checks: Format, generated contracts/guidance, document facts/links, 38/38 syntax cases, three exact catalogues and two semantic baseline metadata checks passed. No feature snapshot or version-lock rebuild.
latestLocalAcceptance.regressions: Sixteen semantic cases cover exact versions, enum/types, optional guards, aliases/mutations/unknown effects, no raw argument content, malformed/future baselines, CLI/preview/shipped-panel consistency and nonfatal notices.

semanticScope.parameterOptions: uiWorkspace.startSession: prompt, agentPreset, clearPreviousDraft and rc.3 whenDraftExists
semanticScope.notices: Official timer.setTimeout/setInterval deprecation and sessions.retain lifetime prerequisites; no removal/leak proof.
semanticScope.provenance: rules/severity.json apiSemantics: exact tags, archive hashes and four selected source hashes verified against fixed source archives. Earlier/future hosts remain unreviewed for semantics.

previousLocalAcceptance.scope: Prior bounded-input/private-directory/document-consolidation acceptance; exact source and artifact only.

scope: Default-suite counts from the supplied TAP log; fixtures means test/fixtures/**, other includes support and production files. Optional profiles depend on local inputs. Dated acceptance summaries are preserved, not rerun by this script; detailed history stays in Git.
